notes.text: Available in cPanel 11.42 and later; operates on the selected cPanel account. Omitted optional inputs, including null, retain server behavior; explicit false, zero and empty strings remain distinct. Literal dotted services.* wire names are form or query keys, not nested request objects.

Returns an application's minimum required password strength as an optional integer strength field, on the documented 0 to 100 scale. The supplied application selects the requirement; no password is sent and this does not measure a candidate password's strength.
